description: Evaluates a script you type on the panel once per sample and for every polyphonic channel, sending the result out as a voltage

params.text: Sets the value of the variable a in the script, -1 to +1
Sets the value of the variable b in the script, -1 to +1
Sets the value of the variable c in the script, -1 to +1
Sets the value of the variable d in the script, -1 to +1
Sets the value of the variable e in the script, -1 to +1

inputs.text: A voltage read into the script variable w, one value per polyphonic channel
A voltage read into the script variable x, one value per polyphonic channel
A voltage read into the script variable y, one value per polyphonic channel
A voltage read into the script variable z, one value per polyphonic channel
A phase input, read into the script variable t with -5V mapped to 0 and +5V to 1; a cable here also fixes how many channels the script runs for

outputs.text: Carries the value of the last expression in the script, one channel per channel the script ran for, and 0V where the result is not a number
Carries whatever the script assigns to the variable out1, one channel per channel the script ran for
Carries whatever the script assigns to the variable out2, one channel per channel the script ran for

notes: a new module holds no script and writes nothing to any output; click into the large text area on the panel and type one there, and the lamp turns green once it compiles
the script is typed into the display on the panel, and every change recompiles it and clears all variables and buffers
the lamp shows green while the script compiles and blinks red while it does not
a script can use four buffers of 4096 values, sixteen ring buffers of 48000 samples, eight variables v1 to v8 that persist between samples, four Schmitt triggers and two DC blockers
the factory presets are worked examples: an oscillator, a filter, a comb filter, a stereo delay, sequencers, a line segment envelope and a phase distortion sweep
menu: Channels from — chooses which input sets the channel count when nothing is patched to t, from Max, x, y, z and w, Max taking the largest of the four
